function.mechanism: Acts as an alkaline leavening/pH-control system in food formulations under GMP conditions.

adi.basis: No finalized EFSA numeric ADI was retrievable; OpenEFSA records EFSA-Q-2011-00653 and EFSA-Q-2011-00654 are ongoing re-evaluations.

efsa.key_finding: EFSA records for E503(i)/(ii) are in Ongoing Risk Assessment; EFSA notes the additive is authorised in the EU, re-evaluation is delayed, and a new data call is likely in 2026/2027.

adi.basis: NOT SPECIFIED (ammonium carbonate and ammonium hydrogen carbonate entries).

concerns.summary: A recent in vitro oral-cell-model study reported ammonium bicarbonate can alter interactions between astringent compounds and oral constituents; this is mechanistic evidence, not direct clinical toxicity evidence.
Recent PubMed searches found limited modern additive-specific oral animal/human safety studies for E503, leaving a contemporary evidence gap while EFSA re-evaluation is pending.

no_concern_confirmed: JECFA lists ADI as NOT SPECIFIED for ammonium carbonate and ammonium hydrogen carbonate (evaluation year 1982).
US FDA/eCFR lists ammonium bicarbonate and ammonium carbonate in 21 CFR Part 184 as GRAS direct food ingredients under current good manufacturing practice conditions.
No specific IARC monograph classification was identified for ammonium carbonates in the retrieved IARC records.

adi_exceedance.notes: Numeric ADI exceedance assessment is not directly applicable to JECFA 'not specified' ADI; EFSA numeric ADI was not retrievable from current ongoing records.

risk_assessment.rationale: Regulatory evidence is broadly permissive (FDA GRAS and JECFA ADI not specified), with no major-ban or IARC classification signal identified. The main uncertainty is the pending/delayed EFSA re-evaluation and sparse recent additive-specific oral toxicology literature.
key_factors: FDA GRAS affirmations in 21 CFR 184.1135 and 184.1137
EFSA E503 re-evaluation status is ongoing and delayed (no finalized output retrieved)
Limited recent direct safety literature specific to E503
